title: Memory leak causing application crash after 48 hours
root_cause: Unused resources were not released, causing continuous memory allocation until application crash
solution: Profile memory usage, identify leaked resources, release unused objects, and add memory monitoring

title: Race condition causing random failure
root_cause: Multiple threads accessed shared resources without proper synchronization
solution: Add locks, improve thread synchronization, and ensure thread safety

title: Debugger showing different behavior from compiler
root_cause: Compiler optimization and different build configurations changed program behavior
solution: Check compiler flags, disable optimization, clean and rebuild the project

title: Package version conflict breaking application
root_cause: Incompatible package versions caused runtime failures
solution: Update dependencies, check compatibility, and lock package versions

title: Old undocumented code causing unexpected failure
root_cause: Unknown architecture and technical debt caused unexpected behavior
solution: Analyze codebase, document system behavior, and refactor carefully

title: Production-only bug cannot reproduce locally
root_cause: Differences between local and production configuration caused failure
solution: Match environments, improve logging, and reproduce production setup

title: Stack trace points to wrong file
root_cause: Actual failure happened earlier but error appeared in another component
solution: Trace execution flow, inspect related components, and add detailed logging

title: Trailing whitespace breaking code
root_cause: Invisible formatting characters affected code execution
solution: Clean formatting, use linting tools, and check hidden characters

title: CSS overflow issue
root_cause: Incorrect container sizing and responsive layout rules
solution: Inspect CSS properties, check element sizes, and fix layout calculations

title: DLL mismatch causing application failure
root_cause: Missing or incompatible dynamic libraries caused runtime errors
solution: Verify installed libraries, replace DLL files, and check compatibility

title: Twenty year old software bug
root_cause: Old design assumptions and undocumented behavior caused failures
solution: Study historical code, reproduce issue, and patch carefully

title: Database connection failure
root_cause: Database server unavailable or incorrect credentials
solution: Verify database URL, credentials, and server availability

title: JWT authentication failure
root_cause: Expired token or incorrect secret configuration
solution: Generate new token and verify authentication settings

title: API timeout error
root_cause: Request exceeded allowed processing time
solution: Optimize API performance and configure timeout values

title: Environment variable missing
root_cause: Required configuration values were not loaded
solution: Update .env file and validate configuration during startup

title: Async await error
root_cause: Async function was called without await keyword
solution: Use await correctly and verify asynchronous execution flow

title: Pydantic validation failure
root_cause: Request data did not match expected schema
solution: Validate input fields and update request model

title: Docker build failure
root_cause: Incorrect Dockerfile commands or missing dependencies
solution: Review Dockerfile instructions and rebuild image

title: React state not updating
root_cause: Incorrect state mutation prevented UI refresh
solution: Use proper state setters and immutable updates

title: OpenAI API authentication failure
root_cause: Invalid API key or incorrect API configuration
solution: Update API credentials and verify environment configuration
